exposure: Robson's 10-group classification of women giving birth
outcome: Cesarean section rates per Robson group
cohort: Women who gave birth by cesarean section in the Specialist Gynecologic and Obstetric Hospital in Walbrzych, Poland, between January 1, 2010, and December 31, 2015.
finding: The overall cesarean section rate was 24.76%, with Robson's Group 1 (nulliparous women with term cephalic pregnancy in spontaneous labor) and Group 5 (multiparous women with single term cephalic pregnancy with a previous cesarean section) accounting for an increasing proportion of all cesarean sections over the study period, primarily due to higher rates in Group 5.
mod_finding: To rationalize the cesarean section rate, efforts should focus on encouraging natural childbirth for women with a history of cesarean section (Robson Group 5) and optimizing medical indications for primary cesarean deliveries (Robson Groups 1 and 2).
